title: Acceptance And Repeated Operation Dossiers
scope: Sixty-four Phase 65 named-file records tested against validation, acceptance, recurring operation, and comparable outcome for the same eight Phase 61 files.
interpretation_boundary: A reviewed record changes only the exact same-entity downstream question it satisfies. Authority, commitment, construction, planning, adjacent assets, other entities, and one-time observations do not transfer into acceptance, repeat operation, or outcome evidence.

stage_taxonomy.label: Validation
stage_taxonomy.question: Does a same-entity record document the named inspection, test, compliance check, qualification, result, exception, correction, or retest?

stage_taxonomy.label: Acceptance
stage_taxonomy.question: Does a named receiving authority or customer accept the defined asset, service, product, cutover, occupancy, or operating condition?

stage_taxonomy.label: Recurring operation
stage_taxonomy.question: Does the record establish compatible repeated service, output, use, monitoring, shipment, or operation for the same entity?

stage_taxonomy.label: Comparable outcome
stage_taxonomy.question: Does a repeated series preserve entity, period, definition, method, denominator, and receiving-system acceptance well enough to support an outcome claim?

dossier_rows.exact_next_artifact: A facility-specific accepted utility, inspection, occupancy, qualification, customer-acceptance, or compatible recurring production record.
dossier_rows.stop_rule: Do not infer accepted service or campus-wide output from utility territory, an agreement, construction status, or one facility claim.
dossier_rows.interpretation_boundary: The City-relayed Fab 1 volume-production statement remains a bounded single observation. Construction, planning, workforce, water, and agreement records do not establish accepted utility service, customer qualification, or a compatible recurring facility series.

stage_decisions.basis: Facility-specific inspection, utility acceptance, equipment qualification, and customer qualification remain open.
stage_decisions.exact_qualifying_artifact: A same-entity facility-specific inspection, utility acceptance, equipment or product qualification, customer acceptance, and a compatible repeat production series.

stage_decisions.basis: No selected event establishes accepted service, customer acceptance, or accepted product.
stage_decisions.exact_qualifying_artifact: A named receiving-authority or customer acceptance record. Facility-specific inspection, utility acceptance, equipment or product qualification, customer acceptance, and a compatible repeat production series.

stage_decisions.basis: A bounded Fab 1 volume-production claim exists without a compatible recurring facility series.
stage_decisions.exact_qualifying_artifact: A compatible repeated-operation record for the same entity. Facility-specific inspection, utility acceptance, equipment or product qualification, customer acceptance, and a compatible repeat production series.

stage_decisions.basis: Stable facility-level output, workforce, water, reliability, cost, and compliance outcomes are not established.
stage_decisions.exact_qualifying_artifact: A repeated outcome series with stable identity, period, definition, method, denominator, and acceptance. Facility-specific inspection, utility acceptance, equipment or product qualification, customer acceptance, and a compatible repeat production series.

stage_decisions.basis: No stable project-level housing delivery or occupancy outcome series is established.

stage_decisions.basis: Recurring monitoring, incident, override, correction, and independent-review evidence is not established.

stage_decisions.exact_qualifying_artifact: A repeated outcome series with stable identity, period, definition, method, denominator, and acceptance. cross_file_rules: The named entity and exact asset, system, site, operator, institution, or project scope must match.
The record must name the downstream authority, test, acceptance event, repeated series, or outcome definition it supports.
An adjacent entity, corridor aggregate, planning baseline, forecast, permit obligation, or general programme record cannot be transferred into a named-file stage.
A single accepted event does not establish recurring operation; repeated operation does not establish a comparable outcome without stable definitions and denominators.
Any future stage change requires a real source review and the existing Phase 60-64 propagation contract.
